task: Support exact implementation ancestry validation in release CI
observation: Actual PR CI checkout logs show fetch-depth 1. The strict evidence repair validates historical implementation SHA ancestry, which requires commits omitted by a shallow checkout. The workflow currently supplies only the merge candidate by default.
impact: Release provenance validation can reject legitimate integrated evidence when history is unavailable; missing history must not be treated as valid evidence. No actual release failure has been observed yet.

resolution.summary: Coordinator branch changes every isolated PR/release checkout to fetch-depth 0; requires CI and review before integration.
